title: Model-Independent Limits on the Line-of-Sight Depth of Clusters of Galaxies Using X-ray and Sunyaev-Zel'dovich Data

evidence.locator: Sect. II: the half-pressure depth is the length of sight line that holds half the integrated pressure; X-ray surface brightness and the Compton parameter bound it from below with no assumption on geometry or equilibrium. Sect. IV, the Bullet Cluster: a region of radius 182 kpc (0.691 arcmin; H0 71, matter 0.23, redshift 0.296) on the main component's X-ray centre, Chandra ObsID 5356 and APEX-SZ; Eq. 19: the half-pressure depth is at least 400 +/- 56 kpc; Eq. 21: at least 0.92 of the half-pressure width on the sky, about 435 kpc. The main component is at least spherical, if not longer along the sight line.
